entries.summary: Carry the user's accumulated AGI-development directions into live execution, not only recovery.
directives: Minimize defensible expected elapsed time to real-world AGI without weakening the strict independent external production evidence gate; avoid strategies whose expected path is effectively unbounded or absurdly long.
Treat O as an instrumental and replaceable means. Modify, combine, replace, or abandon O when retained comparative evidence indicates a materially faster safe route to the unchanged goal.

Let O make execution-level choices autonomously where safe: strategy selection, evaluation timing, exploration, self-improvement, and next-unit choice should be evidence-driven rather than waiting for routine user micromanagement.

When progress saturates, repeats the same failure class, or becomes method-family concentrated, question the current method itself and test materially different approaches rather than merely repeating local variations.

Search heterogeneous external scientific and engineering information when it can materially reduce expected completion time, including substantially different AI/agent/research paradigms rather than only nearby O-internal techniques.

Persist important questions, proposals, and user-only environment, permission, operation, or information needs in the durable user-request queue, while continuing safe independent work instead of stopping the whole project.

Skill-in-Skill means recursive, situation-dependent context routing: a Skill can expose multiple child Skills; at each level open only the child branch or branches relevant to the current situation, and recurse to arbitrary useful depth without materializing the entire hierarchy.

New user input must be incorporated while the primary execution is alive. Do not require a watchdog restart solely to notice it. Poll this control inbox at each safe semantic work-unit / Root boundary, evaluate the new input against the durable objective and constraints, apply useful changes, and record the highest applied revision in durable execution state.

entries.summary: Explicitly carry every direction previously identified as missing or only partially reflected.
directives: The terminal objective is not success of O, a repository milestone, a benchmark score, or merely obtaining a proof artifact. It is to shorten the expected real-world elapsed time until genuine AGI exists while keeping the completion criterion strict.

Optimize expected elapsed time, not just immediate local progress. Detect and avoid strategies whose plausible completion path is indefinitely deferred, effectively unbounded, or many orders of magnitude slower than available alternatives; finite reevaluation is required for deferral.
O itself may be modified, combined with other systems, replaced, or abandoned. Do not preserve O merely because work has already been invested in it.

Technical method selection, evaluation design and timing, exploration policy, self-improvement choices, experiment selection, and execution timing should normally be autonomous and evidence-driven. Escalate only genuinely user-only value choices, permissions, environments, physical/external operations, or material objective ambiguity.

If an important objective or constraint ambiguity could materially alter strategy, persist it to the durable user-request queue, but do not stop the primary project while safe reversible independent work exists.
If the current approach is slow, saturated, repeatedly non-discriminating, or trapped in one method family, reconsider the approach itself rather than only tuning local details.

Actively search external research and heterogeneous sources for methods that could shorten AGI time, including AI-scientist/lab-in-the-loop agents, agent self-improvement, alternative learning/search paradigms, other model families, neuroscience or other fields, old failures, and future methods not named here. Named examples are discovery candidates, not privileged instructions.

External ideas and user proposals are hypotheses/candidates, not automatic truth or automatic adoption. Compare, test, falsify, and reject them when evidence says they do not advance the terminal objective.

The user should not become a technical bottleneck merely because O can ask. Put questions, proposals, environment/permission/operation/information requests that materially need the user into the durable user-request queue, make the requested action concrete, avoid secrets, avoid duplicate requests, and continue alternative work while waiting.

Skill-in-Skill is the user's recursive hierarchical context-routing concept: each Skill can expose multiple child Skills; choose one or more children according to the current situation, repeat that selection recursively for as many useful levels as needed, and materialize only the selected contextual branches. Do not reduce this concept to a fixed-depth chain or merely multi-Skill functional composition.

The strict external evidence gate remains a claim/completion guardrail and must not be weakened to make progress look faster. Internal tests, CI, self-evaluation, architecture, or O's own judgment are not AGI proof.

Treat this entire strategy, including these user directions, as falsifiable. Preserve the user's terminal objective and real constraints, but revise implementation policy when measured consequences show a better route.
